planets.name: TOI-2285 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2285 with a 13.6-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-2285 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2285. Its orbit and size follow Fukui et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname FUKUI_2025): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 13.635109, pl_radj 0.1579091, pl_bmassj 0.06135386

quotes.title: TOI-2285 b
quotes.card: TOI-2285 b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet in orbit around the M-type star TOI-2285.
